newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 12.351 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 12.351 mln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan auctioned 10-year federal investment bonds (FIBs) worth a total of 12.351 million rupees on Saturday .

The bank said it had accepted bids worth 12.351 million rupees at 99.90 rupees and above for the 10-year bonds. No bids were received for five- and 10-year bonds. The auction is set for settlement on Monday.

At the last auction on November 25, the bank accepted bids worth 100.003 million rupees at par for three-year bonds and 434.529 million rupees at par for 10-year bonds. It received no bids for five-year bonds.
